one_line: Mostly clean day; one overstated GitLab headline and minor grounding slips in Currents.

findings.quote: GitLab lets Claude Code and Cursor work inside its platform, with every session logged
findings.instruction: Replace 'every session logged' with wording that matches the source: organisations can record qualifying agent sessions (user, agent, project, timing). Example: 'GitLab 19.5 lets Claude Code and Cursor work inside its platform, with qualifying sessions logged'.

findings.quote: Security teams can now see which outside coding agents touched which projects, instead of inferring it from commits.
findings.instruction: Hedge to match the source: only qualifying sessions are recorded, so say security teams can see which agents touched which projects for logged sessions.
The source says orchestration gains are largest on local hardware, not that it is the only route. Rewrite the take to say local orchestration gains most, without claiming 'only'.

The flagged claim about the monitoring item governing a model without retraining is unsupported, since the source describes SFT-to-RL alignment interventions. Reword the synthesis so it does not say the monitoring item avoids retraining.

findings.quote: Controls fail at their weakest touchpoint.
findings.instruction: Delete this aphoristic closing slogan, or replace it with a sentence about today's three stories.

note: verdict rule: major >= 1 (A reader would notice this. Ratifiable with notes, and worth a look before it ships.) | 1 echo(es) not counted: the same defect filed again in another field or under another criterion
